control.description-key: Read-only Leaflet map for Canvas apps with markers and selection outputs.

property.name: AssetsJson
property.description-key: JSON array of marker records filtered by the Canvas app. Use [] for no markers.

property.name: RoadsGeoJson
property.description-key: GeoJSON geometry, feature or feature collection. Empty FeatureCollection hides shapes.

property.name: UseDemoData
property.description-key: Use fictional equipment and roads when the corresponding JSON input is blank.

property.name: ShowBasemap
property.description-key: Allow online OpenStreetMap and configured custom tile providers. Turn off for a network-free schematic.

property.name: LabelPosition
property.description-key: Marker label direction: bottom, top, left or right.

property.name: LabelOffsetX
property.description-key: Horizontal marker label adjustment in pixels.

property.name: LabelOffsetY
property.description-key: Vertical marker label adjustment in pixels.

property.name: MapTitle
property.description-key: Legacy property retained for compatibility; the map does not display a title.

property.name: ImageCatalogJson
property.description-key: JSON array of imageKey and imageUrl records for markers.

property.name: MarkerHtmlTemplate
property.description-key: Optional maker-authored marker template with text placeholders and an imageUrl placeholder.

property.name: HtmlCatalogJson
property.description-key: JSON array of htmlKey and html records for individual marker templates.

property.name: CustomTileProvidersJson
property.description-key: Optional JSON array of tile providers with name, URL, attribution, maxNativeZoom and optional API key.

property.name: SelectedAssetId
property.description-key: Stable ID selected inside the PCF. Empty when cleared or filtered out.

property.name: SelectedAssetJson
property.description-key: Selected equipment record as JSON. Empty when no selection.

property.name: SelectionVersion
property.description-key: Increments for every marker selection, including repeated selections.

property.name: ValidationMessage
property.description-key: Input validation issues, or empty when valid.
